issue_context.title: A better error handling on backup & restore.
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

Some unpredictable errors from storage appear from time to time. we cannot rely on the allow-error-list to determine whether the error can be retry or not. So I think we should use block-list instead.
comments: @3pointer please check whether this issue happened in v6.1？ if yes, please add a label "affects-6.1". thanks

review_comments: Why store id is a uuid?🤔
because during restore. we cannot get store id
